title: Flash ADC
text: N-bit ADC with flash architecture, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Edge trigger type} sets Clock; {Number of bits} sets the number of physical output bits, {Input range (V)} sets the aDC dynamic range, {Use external start clock} sets the connect to external start conversion clock, {Conversion start frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start conversion clock, {RMS aperture jitter (s)} sets the rMS aperture jitter added to the start conversion clock, {Match input scale} sets the inherit output polarity and data type, {Output polarity} Defines ADC output polarity, {Output data type} Defines ADC output data type fixdt, {Simulate using} defines how to simulate ADC, {Enable Linearity Impairments} enables linearity impairments in ADC, {Offset error} sets the shifts quantization steps by specific value, {Gain error} sets the error on slope of ADC transfer curve, {Missing codes} sets the position of the failed comparators, {Enable Timing Impairments} enables timing impairments in ADC, {Conversion delay (s)} sets the latency of ADC, {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size} sets the number of extra buffer filters. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: start
ports.summary: External clock to start conversion scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Determines whether analog to digital conversion is complete scalar

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of physical output bits 10 (default) | positive real integer in the range [1, 26]

params.name: Use external start clock
params.values: Connect to external start conversion clock on (default) | off

params.name: Conversion start frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of internal start conversion clock 1e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: RMS aperture jitter (s)
params.values: RMS aperture jitter added to the start conversion clock 1e-12 (default) | real nonnegative scalar

params.name: Edge trigger type
params.values: Clock edge type that triggers the output update Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge

params.name: Match input scale
params.values: Inherit output polarity and data type from input off (default) | on

params.name: Output polarity
params.values: Defines ADC output polarity Auto (default) | Bipolar | Unipolar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Defines ADC output data type fixdt(1,Nbits) (default) | fixdt(0,Nbits) | double | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Define how to simulate ADC Simulink blocks (default) | System object (interpreted) | System object (code generation)

params.name: Enable Linearity Impairments
params.values: Enable linearity impairments in ADC simulation off (default) | on

params.name: Offset error
params.values: Shifts quantization steps by specific value 3 LSB (default) | real scalar

params.name: Gain error
params.values: Error on slope of ADC transfer curve 2 LSB (default) | real scalar

params.name: Missing codes
params.values: Position of the failed comparators [] (default) | row vector with positive real values

params.name: Enable Timing Impairments
params.values: Enable timing impairments in ADC simulation off (default) | on

params.name: Conversion delay (s)
params.values: Latency of ADC 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of extra buffer filters 100 (default) | positive real scalar
